14. Ethane is known as a saturated hydrocarbon. Why?
Ans:- Ethane is known as a saturated hydrocarbon because it contains only single covalent bonds between its carbon atoms.

2. Study the structural formula given below and answer the following questions:
i) Write the IUPAC name of it.
Ans:- Its IUPAC name is propane-1,2,3- triol.
ii) In which group of organic compound is it kept?
Ans:- Glycerol (also known as glycerin) is primarily classified into the organic compound group called alcohols. Specifically,
because it contains three hydroxyl (-OH) groups, it is more precisely categorized as a trihydric alcohol or a triol.
iii) Which type of hydrocarbon is formed if the ‘OH’ are replaced by three ‘H’ atom?
Ans:- If the three hydroxyl (-OH) groups in glycerol are replaced by three hydrogen (H) atoms, the resulting hydrocarbon is
propane. And Propane belongs to the group of saturated hydrocarbons, also known as alkanes.
iv) Give two reason to use this compound in fruits and food materials.
Ans:- Glycerol is used in food and fruits as a humectant to retain moisture and maintain a soft, pliable texture. It also acts as a
preservative by reducing water activity to inhibit the growth of bacteria and mold, thereby extending shelf life.
